notes: No cross-service ordering is required. Both customer versions retain the offer.queued event shape and consent.check operation; the new notifier accepts only explicit consent, so it is safe with either customer version. Deploy notifier instances one at a time. During a mixed rollout, old notifier instances may still send beyond the new two-per-day cap; once all instances are new, the shared sent plus capped history enforces it. Retain capped and offer_day_lock on rollback.
